author: Jamie R.
review: Best dental office in town. The whole team is so kind and the front desk made everything easy. Highly recommend!

author: Morgan T.
review: I was terrified of dentists but everyone here is so gentle and patient. I actually look forward to coming back now.

author: Dana P.
review: Dr. Lee did an amazing job on my root canal and crown - zero pain and they explained every step. Best experience I've ever had at a dentist.

author: Alex K.
review: Waited 45 minutes past my appointment time and no one apologized. The cleaning itself was fine but the front desk was rude about my bill.

author: Sam W.
review: Billed me for an extraction I never agreed to and the office refused to explain the charges. Extremely frustrating - avoid.

author: Riley J.
review: The hygienist was lovely and gentle but the office is dated and parking is a nightmare. Mixed feelings overall.

author: Casey M.
review: Friendly staff and a calming environment. They never make you feel rushed.

author: Pat D.
review: My filling fell out two weeks after they placed it and getting a follow-up appointment has been impossible.
